notes: Hand-edited shared defaults for the Valuation Inputs and Valuation Model tabs (js/14-valuation.js). Source: workbook 20261027_Exchanges_Dashboard.xlsx, values of 16 Nov 2026: the 'Valuation Inputs' sheet (ADR estimate, QoQ ADR growth, method weights) and the BSE, MCX and NSE sheets (P/E, FY28 other income, PAT margin, sessions, discounts), except discount_to_today_pct: 6.75 % from 25 Nov 2026 (the workbook's was 9 %). 'editable' values are the starting points each browser can override on the Valuation Inputs tab; 'fixed' values are shown but not editable there. adr_estimate_cr null = use the current 45-session ADR. regression_from = the first date of the valuation's regression data (revenue and prices; the 45 DMA is built from it, as in the workbook), null = all data in the share file (the published fit). MCX other income is other operating revenue 291.2605 + other income 175.329, the PAT margin applied to both. MCX competition: the Competition tab's assumed shares of NSE's commodity volume that would otherwise trade on MCX, on ordinary days and in NSE's options expiry window (its expiry day and the day before), for its estimated revenue loss (js/19-mcx-competition.js); each browser can override them there. They are judgements: 100 % on ordinary days is the upper end, and 30 % in the expiry window because MCX's own volume shows no consistent dip on NSE's expiry days. This file is the only copy: if it fails to load, both tabs say so and show no targets.
